scenes.headline: How tapering the MLP width buys a better model
scenes.sub: Tapered Language Models: move width to the early layers.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lemon! Every transformer since 2017 stacks identical layers. Tapered Language Models ask what happens if you don't.

scenes.text: Layers don't do equal work. Give early layers more MLP width and late ones less, on a cosine schedule, with the same total.
scenes.say: Layers don't do equal work. So give the early layers more MLP width and the late ones less, on a cosine schedule, keeping the same total.

scenes.title: Not every layer does the same job

left.title: Early layers transform
items: Updates point away from the residual stream
left.say: Early layers rewrite the representation. Their updates point away from the residual stream. That's real transformation.

right.title: Late layers refine
items: MLP outputs align with the residual stream
right.say: Late layers mostly refine. Their MLP outputs line up more and more with the stream, so their extra width goes largely unused.

scenes.title: The taper, precisely
scenes.say: Only the MLP's hidden width tapers. Attention stays identical to the baseline.

parts.say: Layer zero starts widest, at one and a half times the baseline.
The last layer ends at half the baseline.

parts.note: a smooth cosine fall across depth
parts.say: A cosine carries the width smoothly down between them.

parts.note: the widths average to the baseline
parts.say: And the widths average to the baseline, so parameters and FLOPs don't change at all.

scenes.title: Where the extra width goes
scenes.note: 440M Transformer perplexity, lower is better, same budget
scenes.say: The control: at a fixed budget, extra width early helps, in the middle hurts, and late is worst of all. Direction is what matters.

scenes.text: Spend width where the work is: early layers transform the stream, late layers only refine it.

recap: Early layers transform; late layers refine
A cosine taper from 1.5x down to 0.5x
Same parameters and FLOPs, lower perplexity
scenes.say: To recap: layers aren't equal, so taper the width and keep the budget.
